title: 第二十五章 侯主真言父辈半生局第二十六章 蛟血开境夜斩阁中刺客
lines: 第二十五章侯主真言，父辈半生局
蟒纹衣袍落地，威压覆满沁柳全院。
镇北侯沈苍立身廊下，身形挺拔如山，中年面容棱角冷硬，眉眼自带王侯威仪，周身武灵境浑厚灵力内敛不泄，却天然压制院内包括执法长老秦守在内所有武者。
武灵境，超脱凡人武徒、武师层级，已是永安郡一方顶尖强者，执掌镇北侯府十余年，权衡派系、执掌生杀，城府深不可测。
院内所有护卫、管事、下人尽数躬身垂首，脊背紧绷，连呼吸都下意识放轻，无人敢直视王侯双目。
唯有庭院中央青衫少年，立身原地，身姿挺直不折，未曾半分屈膝俯首。
沈砚抬眸，静静望着眼前这位侯府之主，心底五味杂陈。
同姓沈，同承侯府沈氏血脉，论宗族辈分，沈苍是他同族叔父。五年前父母被逼出走、背负叛府污名，他孤留侯府西落院，受尽磋磨冷眼，数次险些被三房下人活活打死，沈苍身居主院，始终冷眼旁观，从不曾过问分毫。
往日他只当，侯爷偏心三房，默许柳氏欺压旁支，漠视他生死。
可方才那句惊雷之语，彻底推翻过往所有认知。
当年父母身陷死局，除三房构陷之外，竟还有第二人出手推波助澜。
而能撼动当年沈惊鸿夫妇，能左右侯府局势，身份地位足以比肩三房掌权者，放眼整座镇北侯府，寥寥无几。
嫌疑最大之人，恰恰就是眼前执掌侯府大权的镇北侯，沈苍！
四目隔空相对，空气凝滞无声，暗流疯狂碰撞。
秦守握紧家规玉杖，眉头紧锁，缓步上前躬身开口：“侯爷，今日三房罪责已定，柳氏构陷忠良、私引外阁杀手，罪证确凿，已判废功禁足思过崖，此事……”
“此事，不算了结。”
沈苍抬手，淡淡打断秦守话语，目光自始至终没有离开沈砚分毫，声线低沉厚重，裹挟王侯重量，落至院内每一处角落，“柳氏只是台前棋子，三房不过一把利刃，当年沈惊鸿夫妇被迫离府，从来不是三房一己之力便可成事。”
一语落地，院内躬身众人尽数心神震颤。
原来五年旧案，远比众人想象的更加复杂阴暗！
瘫倒在地的赵坤闻言，赤红眼底骤然亮起微光，拼命撑着身子抬头，满眼希冀看向沈苍。
原来母亲不是主谋，三房只是棋子！那三房罪责便可减轻，母亲或许还有脱离思过崖、重获修为的机会！
被执法护卫押住、即将被拖拽离场的柳氏，身子猛地僵住，散乱发丝下，黯淡眼底重新燃起求生火光，急切嘶吼：“侯爷明鉴！我只是听命行事！当年一切皆是您默许授意！我三房全是替人做事，罪不至死啊！”
垂死关头，柳氏彻底撕破脸面，公然攀咬镇北侯，道出隐秘共谋关系。
全场哗然再起，风声躁动！
原来三房多年肆无忌惮打压沈砚、构陷沈惊鸿，背后竟是镇北侯撑腰默许！
沈砚指尖悄然攥紧，掌心掐出浅浅纹路，心底积攒五年的寒凉，瞬间蔓延四肢百骸。
他可以接受三房为权杀戮、为利构陷，可无法接受，同族至亲，为了权位，亲手布局，毁掉他完整家庭，让他五岁失亲，五年卑贱苟活。
沈砚声音平稳，却藏刺骨凉意，直视沈苍双目，一字一句开口：“侯爷，柳氏所言，是真？”
没有暴怒质问，没有情绪失控，唯有极致冷静。
历经五年磋磨、生死血战，他早已明白，暴怒无用，嘶吼无用，唯有听清全部真相，理清所有因果，才能讨回所有公道。
沈苍神色不变，面对全场惊疑目光，坦然颔首，没有半分遮掩躲闪：“是，当年之事，我知情，且顺水推舟。”
坦然认罪，坦荡至极！
秦守大惊失色，脚步后撤半步，满眼难以置信：“侯爷！您为何如此？沈惊鸿天赋绝世，忠心镇守外院，乃是侯府栋梁，您为何要联合三房，逼走二人？”
在外院所有人心中，沈惊鸿当年忠义无双，战力冠绝侯府，是未来能带领镇北侯府崛起的新一代顶梁柱，沈苍此举，无异于自断臂膀。
“栋梁？于侯府是栋梁，于我，是绊脚石。”
沈苍缓步抬脚，踏过青石地砖，一步步走向沈砚，周身威压缓缓收敛，褪去王侯凌厉，只剩几分复杂怅然，“沈砚，你聪慧隐忍，心性远超同龄武者，今日我便告知你全部过往，是非对错，由你自己评判。”
“五年之前，老侯爷尚在人世，膝下有两名嫡传子弟。”
“其一，便是你父亲，沈惊鸿。天资盖世，十八岁淬体巅峰，二十岁突破武师，武道天赋，百年镇北侯府从古至今无人能及，深得老侯爷偏爱，早已内定为下一任镇北侯继承人。”
“其二，便是我，沈苍。资质中庸，苦修多年方才踏入武师，天赋平平，不受老侯爷看重，一辈子只能做旁支辅臣，无缘侯位。”
开篇寥寥数语，揭开最残酷的宗族权斗根源。
侯位传承，宗族大权，骨肉相争！

Chapter 25: The mantra of the marquis, the half-life situation of the fathers
The python-patterned robe fell to the ground, covering the entire Qinliu courtyard with pressure.
Zhenbei Marquis Shen Cang stood in the corridor, with a body as tall and tall as a mountain, a middle-aged face with hard edges, and a royal majesty in his eyebrows. The strong spiritual power of the martial spirit realm around him was restrained, but he naturally suppressed all the martial artists in the courtyard, including the law enforcement elder Qin Shou.
In the Martial Spirit Realm, he is beyond the level of ordinary martial arts disciples and martial arts masters. He is already the top powerhouse in Yong'an County. He has been in charge of the Zhenbei Hou Mansion for more than ten years. He weighs factions and is in charge of life and death. The city is unfathomable.
All the guards, stewards, and servants in the courtyard bowed their heads, their backs tensed, and they even breathed softly subconsciously. No one dared to look directly into the prince's eyes.
Only the young man in green shirt in the center of the courtyard stood on the same spot, his posture straight and unbent, and he never bowed his knees or bowed his head.
Shen Yan raised his eyes and looked quietly at the Lord of the Hou Mansion in front of him, with mixed feelings in his heart.
He has the same surname as Shen, and shares the bloodline of the Shen family of the Hou Mansion. In terms of clan seniority, Shen Cang is his uncle from the same clan. Five years ago, his parents were forced to run away and he was stigmatized for rebelling against the government. He stayed alone in the Xiluo courtyard of the Hou Mansion, where he was subjected to many criticisms and cold looks. He was almost beaten to death by the servants of the third house several times. Shen Cang lived in the main courtyard and always watched with cold eyes, never interfering in the slightest.
In the past, he only thought that the Marquis was partial to the third wife, tacitly allowed the Liu family to oppress the side branch, and ignored his life and death.
But those shocking words just now completely overturned all previous perceptions.
Back then, my parents were in a deadlock. In addition to the three-room plot, there was actually a second person who took action to add fuel to the flames.
Looking at the entire Zhenbei Hou Mansion, there are only a few people who can shake Shen Jinghong and his wife, control the situation in the Hou Mansion, and whose status is comparable to those in power in the third house.
The person with the greatest suspicion is none other than the Marquis of Zhenbei, Shen Cang, who is in charge of the Marquis Mansion!
The four eyes faced each other in the air, the air was stagnant and silent, and the undercurrents collided wildly.
Qin Shou held the jade staff of the family rules tightly, frowned, slowly stepped forward and bowed and said: "Master Hou, today the guilt of the third house has been determined. The Liu family framed Zhongliang and secretly lured the killer from the outer cabinet. The evidence of the crime is conclusive, and he has been sentenced to be deprived of his power and banned from thinking about crossing the cliff. This matter..."
"This matter is not settled."
Shen Cang raised his hand and lightly interrupted Qin Shou's words. His eyes did not leave Shen Yan at all. His voice was deep and thick, carrying the weight of the prince and falling to every corner of the courtyard. "Liu is just a chess piece in front of the stage, and the third room is nothing more than a sharp blade. When Shen Jinghong and his wife were forced to leave the mansion, it was never the third room that could accomplish anything on their own."
As soon as the words fell to the ground, everyone in the courtyard was trembling.
It turns out that the five-year-old case is far more complicated and darker than everyone imagined!
When Zhao Kun, who was lying on the ground, heard this, his red eyes suddenly shimmered, he desperately held himself up and looked up at Shen Cang with hope.
It turns out that the mother is not the mastermind, and the third bedroom is just a pawn! Then the third room's guilt can be alleviated, and the mother may still have a chance to escape Siguo Cliff and regain her cultivation!
Ms. Liu, who was being held by law enforcement guards and about to be dragged away, froze suddenly. Under her disheveled hair, the fire for survival rekindled in her dim eyes, and she screamed urgently: "Master Hou Ming Jian! I just followed orders! Everything was tacitly authorized by you back then! My third house all worked for others, and the crime will not lead to death!"
At the critical moment, Mrs. Liu completely broke her face and openly bit the Marquis of Zhenbei, revealing the secret conspiracy.
The whole place was in an uproar again, and the wind was stirring!
It turns out that Sanfang has been unscrupulously suppressing Shen Yan and framing Shen Jinghong for many years, but behind it was the support and acquiescence of Zhenbei Hou!
Shen Yan's fingertips clenched quietly, and shallow lines formed in his palms. The coldness accumulated in his heart for five years spread to his limbs and bones in an instant.
He could accept that Sanfang killed and framed for power, but he could not accept that a close relative of his own clan, for the sake of power and position, personally planned and destroyed his entire family, leaving him orphaned at the age of five and living a humble life for five years.
Shen Yan's voice was steady, but there was a biting chill in it. He looked directly into Shen Cang's eyes and spoke word by word: "Master Hou, is what Liu said true?"
There were no angry questions, no emotional outbursts, just extreme calmness.
After five years of hard work and bloody battles of life and death, he has long understood that rage is useless and screaming is useless. Only by hearing the whole truth and sorting out all the cause and effect can he get all justice.
Shen Cang's expression remained unchanged, and he nodded calmly in the face of the surprised and suspicious gazes of the audience, without any attempt to hide or dodge: "Yes, I know what happened back then, and I will follow the trend."
Confess your guilt frankly, be extremely magnanimous!
Qin Shou was shocked and took half a step back. His eyes were full of disbelief: "Master Hou! Why are you like this? Shen Jinghong is extremely talented and loyally guards the outer courtyard. He is the pillar of the Hou Mansion. Why did you unite with the three houses and force the two of them away?"
In the hearts of everyone in the outer courtyard, Shen Jinghong was unparalleled in his loyalty and righteousness, and his combat prowess surpassed that of the Hou Mansion. He was the pillar of the new generation who could lead the rise of the Zhenbei Hou Mansion in the future. Shen Cang's move was tantamount to breaking his own arm.
"A pillar? To the Marquis Mansion, it is a pillar, but to me, it is a stumbling block."
Shen Cang slowly raised his feet, stepped on the bluestone floor tiles, and walked towards Shen Yan step by step. The pressure around him slowly subsided, and the royal arrogance faded away, leaving only a bit of complexity and sadness. "Shen Yan, you are smart and forbearing, and your temperament is far beyond that of a warrior of your age. Today I will tell you the entire past. It is up to you to judge what is right or wrong."
"Five years ago, the old Marquis was still alive and had two direct descendants."
"The first one is your father, Shen Jinghong. He is extremely talented. He reached the peak of body tempering at the age of eighteen and broke through as a martial artist at the age of twenty. His talent in martial arts has been unmatched by anyone in the Zhenbei Marquis Mansion for hundreds of years. He is deeply favored by the old Marquis and has long been designated as the next successor of the Zhenbei Marquis."
"The second one is me, Shen Cang. I have mediocre qualifications. I have practiced hard for many years before becoming a martial artist. My talent is mediocre and I am not valued by the old marquis. I will only be a side minister throughout my life and have no chance of becoming a marquis."
The opening few words reveal the root of the cruelest clan power struggle.
The inheritance of the title, the power of the clan, and the fight between flesh and blood!
title_en: Chapter 25: The Lord’s Mantra: The Half-Life Game of the Fathers Chapter 26: The Blood Dragon Opens the Realm and Kills the Assassins in the Pavilion at Night
